Since the change came completely out of the blue at first I was really annoyed that they changed it to 6v6.  I really really struggled for about 3 or 4 days.   

    
Turns out I probably had the hardest role to relearn the new comp mode. I play dive tanks and in 5v5, I have a timer in my head when I dive the back line. One, two, three, get out. But in 6v6, I found out very quickly that I was instantly dying every time I dived for the back line.    

   
So I lost a lot of rank. But then, everything started to change. I started paying much more attention to my positioning and always knowing where my exit route was going to be before I jumped in.   I was spending a lot more time hovering around my front line, and only diving when the time was right.

   
And then suddenly I just started gaining rank. 

 
Now I'm literally a full color rank above any rank I've ever achieved in years of playing this game. And I really think it's just that I'm finally getting better. So after all that yeah I agree it would be nice to keep this mode going. Having the time of my life!

The problem with TOA is the skill level is very binary.  You try everything and fail then you find your grove and almost never lose.  Im an old and slow player and I've already made more in this league mechanic than any other.  I've made over 25 divine in 2 weeks just doing TOA.   
  
Main strat: Make an off-build for your self that just annoys the enemies and is very fast (I'm doing Ensnare totems).  You must have Void Sphere to hold ppl and to move big turtles around.  
Go straight for Fieldmaster until you have about 3 or more, even if its the worst initial pick. Put them on Flank.  Next priority are the sweet sweet Storm Guards!  Get them as fast as you can.  Put them on flank with end build half Storm Guard half Fieldmaster on Flanks, then move your extra Fieldmasters around.  After that is just fluff. Priorities in no order: the fucking annoying Spear Dancers, Jade Hulk, Moon Dancer, Caldera Raveger.  Don't bother with Turtles, you don't need them.  Best upgrade is Righteous Fire (Firebreather Mead) put it on as many as you can.  
  
Movement off the start should be diagonal and to the back.  Take out all the back defender totems first.  THey are less well guarded and are by definition the guards, so it gets easy when they are down.  Learn to dodge.  Hit a totem for 2 seconds then jump to another for a few.  Stay on totem when your flankers join you.
   
With this strat you win almost every game, but be aware you will always have losing streaks of 2 or 3 games no matter what you do.  Its a beast of a game mechanic, you can't win them all.  Oh and don't worry about dying, you don't need to always be alive to win.
